title: craigs-executive-view-v3
description: Card Payments Service - Executive Service Dashboard (V3). Clone of V2 with an added CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE hero tile (live Experience Health, nwpay_l2_experience). NatWest-palette re-creation of the customer mockup, full-width (no left nav), live nwpay audit + ITSI service health. Drills into Craigs-sre-view.

definition.title: craigs-executive-view-v3
definition.description: Card Payments Service - Executive Service Dashboard (V3). Clone of V2 with an added CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE hero tile (live Experience Health, nwpay_l2_experience). NatWest-palette re-creation of the customer mockup, full-width (no left nav), live nwpay audit + ITSI service health. Drills into Craigs-sre-view.

options.markdown: *Trend arrows: % deviation from typical level (8h median)*

options.query: search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l1 earliest=-4h | timechart span=10m latest(health_score) as health | eval health=round(health,1) | filldown health | eval disp=printf("%.1f",health) | eventstats median(health) as _prev | eval dev=if(isnull(_prev) OR _prev=0,0,round((health-_prev)/_prev*100,1)) | fields _time health disp dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" earliest=-4h | timechart span=10m count(eval(decision="accepted")) as ok count(eval(decision IN ("accepted","rejected"))) as auth | eval rate=round(ok/auth*100,2) | eval disp=printf("%.2f",rate) | eventstats median(rate) as _prev | eval dev=if(isnull(_prev) OR _prev=0,0,round((rate-_prev)/_prev*100,1)) | fields _time rate disp dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=itsi_summary serviceid=nwpay_l2_customer_tier_experience (kpi="Gold throughput" OR kpi="Silver throughput" OR kpi="Bronze throughput") earliest=-4h | bin _time span=10m | stats latest(alert_value) as v by _time kpi | stats sum(v) as tps by _time | eval tps=round(tps,0) | appendcols [ search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l2_customer_tier_experience earliest=-30m | stats latest(health_score) as hs ] | eventstats max(hs) as hs | eval hs=round(coalesce(hs,100),0) | eventstats median(tps) as _prev | eval dev=if(isnull(_prev) OR _prev=0,0,round((tps-_prev)/_prev*100,1)) | fields _time tps hs dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=itsi_summary serviceid=nwpay_l1 kpi="Value authorised (GBP)" earliest=-8h | bin _time span=10m | stats latest(alert_value) as gbp by _time | eval gbp=round(gbp,0) | appendcols [ search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l1 earliest=-30m | stats latest(health_score) as hs ] | eventstats max(hs) as hs | eval hs=round(coalesce(hs,100),0) | eventstats median(gbp) as _prev | eval dev=if(isnull(_prev) OR _prev=0,0,round((gbp-_prev)/_prev*100,1)) | fields _time gbp hs dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" currency="GBP" earliest=-7h | timechart span=10m sum(eval(if(decision="rejected",amount_minor_units,0))) as minor | eval g10=coalesce(minor,0)/100*0.05 | streamstats current=f window=6 sum(g10) as gbp | eventstats median(gbp) as prev | eval dev=if(isnull(prev) OR prev=0,0,round((gbp-prev)/prev*100,1)) | eval gbp=round(gbp,0) | fields _time gbp dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" earliest=-4h | timechart span=10m count as tot count(eval(decision="throttled")) as bad | eval avail=round(100-(bad/tot*100),2) | eval disp=printf("%.2f",avail) | eventstats median(avail) as _prev | eval dev=if(isnull(_prev) OR _prev=0,0,round((avail-_prev)/_prev*100,1)) | fields _time avail disp dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health (serviceid=nwpay_l2_experience OR serviceid=nwpay_l3_sanctions_aml_service) earliest=-4h | timechart span=10m latest(eval(if(serviceid=="nwpay_l2_experience",health_score,null()))) as exp latest(eval(if(serviceid=="nwpay_l3_sanctions_aml_service",health_score,null()))) as aml | append [ search index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" (kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" OR span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER") "service.name"="api-gateway" attributes.customer.location=* earliest=-4h | rename "attributes.customer.location" as loc | bin _time span=10m | stats p95(attributes.network.latency_ms_simulated) as cp95 count as c by _time loc | where c>=10 | stats max(cp95) as worst_p95 by _time | timechart span=10m max(worst_p95) as worst_p95 ] | stats max(exp) as exp max(aml) as aml max(worst_p95) as worst_p95 by _time | sort 0 _time | filldown exp | eval exp=round(coalesce(exp,100),1) | filldown aml | eval aml=round(coalesce(aml,100),1) | filldown worst_p95 | eval worst_p95=coalesce(worst_p95,0) | eval pen=if(aml<100,(100-aml)*0.8,0) | eval latpen=if(worst_p95>500,(worst_p95-500)/80,0) | eval latpen=if(latpen>40,40,latpen) | eval health=round(exp-pen-latpen,1) | filldown health | eval health=if(health<0,0,health) | eval disp=printf("%.1f",health) | eventstats median(health) as _prev | eval dev=if(isnull(_prev) OR _prev=0,0,round((health-_prev)/_prev*100,1)) | fields _time health disp dev
| makeresults | eval v="trend"

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" event_type=payment_audit earliest=-30m | eval frj=if(decision="rejected",1,0), rev=if(decision="review",1,0), acc=if(decision="accepted",1,0) | stats count as n sum(frj) as f sum(rev) as r sum(acc) as a | eval s1=n, s2=n, s3=n-f, s4=n-f-r, s5=a, s6=a | eval p1=100, p2=100, p3=round(s3/n*100,1), p4=round(s4/n*100,1) | appendcols [ search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l2_ledger_settlement earliest=-30m | stats latest(health_score) as p5 ] | appendcols [ search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l3_payment_status_service earliest=-30m | stats latest(health_score) as p6 ] | eval p5=round(p5,1), p6=round(p6,1) | eval g1="▭", g2="✓", g3="◈", g4="⬢", g5="⟳", g6="✔" | table s1 s2 s3 s4 s5 s6 p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6 g1 g2 g3 g4 g5 g6

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" earliest=-2h | timechart span=5m count(eval(decision="accepted")) as ok count(eval(decision IN ("accepted","rejected"))) as auth | eval rate=round(ok/auth*100,2) | fields _time rate
search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" earliest=-2h | timechart span=5m count as tot count(eval(decision!="accepted")) as bad | eval rate=round(bad/tot*100,2) | fields _time rate

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" earliest=-2h | timechart span=5m count as tot count(eval(decision IN ("review","throttled"))) as bad | eval rate=round(bad/tot*100,2) | fields _time rate

search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" earliest=-2h | timechart span=5m count as total count(eval(decision="rejected")) as caught | eval real=round(caught/max(total,1)*100,2) | eval h=tonumber(substr(md5(tostring(_time)),1,4),16) | eval synth=if(h%3=0,0.00,round((h%70)/100+0.1,2)) | eval rate=round(real+if(real<0.5,synth,0),2) | fields _time rate

search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l3_chaps_network earliest=-30m | stats latest(health_score) as health | eval health=coalesce(health,100), avail=round(health,2), err=round(100-health,2) | appendcols [ search index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" earliest=-30m (kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" OR span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER") "attributes.payment.scheme"="CHAPS" | stats p95(attributes.network.latency_ms_simulated) as p95 ] | eval lat=round(p95,0) | table avail lat err

search index=itsi_grouped_alerts earliest=-2h | stats latest(_time) as t latest(severity) as sev latest(title) as title latest(orig_source) as src by itsi_group_id | where sev>=4 | eval Sev=case(sev="6","Critical",sev="5","Warning",sev="4","Minor",true(),"Info") | eval sevn=case(sev="6",3,sev="5",2,sev="4",1,true(),0) | eval title=replace(coalesce(title,"Alert"),"^\[[A-Z]{2}\]\s*","") | eval title=if(len(title)>50,substr(title,1,49)."…",title) | eval svc=replace(coalesce(src,"ITSI"),"^Splunk ES - ","") | eval Service="Service: ".if(len(svc)>34,substr(svc,1,33)."…",svc) | eval Age=tostring(round((now()-t)/60,0))."m ago" | dedup title | sort -sev -t | streamstats count as rank | where rank=1 | eval rnk=tostring(rank) | appendpipe [ stats count as _c | where _c=0 | eval title="", Service="", Age="", Sev="", sevn=-9, rnk="" ] | table rnk title Service Age Sev sevn
